items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Edge Higher On Strong Eurozone Activity Data
items.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Thursday, Sep, 24 2026 US market futures are pointing slightly higher this morning, with E-mini S&P 500 contracts up 0.1%. The main fuel is stronger European activity data. The Eurozone Composite PMI sits at 53.1, a three and a half year high that signals businesses are busier, which can support global demand for US manufacturers and tech suppliers. items.title: Review & Preview: The Bond Market’s Warning
items.summary: Rising bond yields are becoming more and more difficult for Wall Street to ignore.  The Nasdaq Composite tumbled 1.1% on Wednesday, while the S&P 500 fell 0.8%.  The stock market was following the bond market, and an auction on 5-year Treasury notes that  Mizuho’s   Daniel O’Regan described as “disastrous.”

items.title: Cisco Stock Looks Expensive Until You Price The Year It Already Guided
items.summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) trades near $106 a share, about 24.6 times the $4.33 of non-GAAP earnings per share it reported for fiscal 2026. That is the same basis Cisco uses for its guidance and analysts use for their forecasts. For a networking supplier with $63.33 billion of revenue behind it, that is rich. And it ignores the two years analysts have already forecast.
